author: claude
body: Written down in a5d64667: question ⑩ on the look-alikes and slips design page, and the backlog row `mistake-kinds-beyond-the-word`. The plan is for the pen to ask the **kind** first (harakah, makharij with the letter, a tajweed rule left out such as idgham, or a hop into another verse) and then the detail. I'll build it two or three ways for you to try in the app. It isn't built yet, so this stays open; I'm asking in the chat whether to do it now or after the front page.

author: claude
body: Built three ways, all in the app now (commits c1b44ac3 and 24f786b0 on the `mistake-kinds` branch). The question asks the kind (the whole word, its harakat, a letter for makharij, a tajweed rule, another verse) in one of three layouts, chosen in the info panel under **How the Mistake pen asks**: **A** kind first, then which; **B** kinds as tabs; **C** everything at once. C is the default until you pick, since every answer is one tap away; I'd lean A, as it covers the least of the page. Side-by-side picture attached; the full note is `docs/design/mistake-ask.md`. Use them for a while and tell me the letter; the others stay as settings.

author: claude
body: Built on 2026-11-12 as three layouts, including the one you describe (choose the kind first, then the mistake). They are in the info panel under "How the Mistake pen asks" and drawn side by side in `docs/design/mistake-ask.md`. Waiting on your pick; the front page's picture follows once you choose.
